about.title: Atalya Law Firm
about.metaDescription: Atalya Law Firm, based in Antalya, provides reliable legal counsel across criminal, family, labor, commercial and real estate law, among other areas.
about.intro: Atalya Law Firm is based in Antalya and provides individual and corporate clients with reliable, solution-oriented and transparent legal counsel across a wide range of practice areas. With our experienced team of attorneys, we defend our clients' rights as effectively as possible in criminal, family, labor, commercial, real estate, enforcement & bankruptcy, inheritance and contract law, among others.
about.approachBody: We handle every case on its own merits and maintain clear, regular communication with our clients throughout the process. We keep you informed at every stage and lay out the risks and options clearly. Our goal isn't just to conclude a case — it's to build solid, sustainable legal solutions that protect our clients' rights from the very start.
about.localBody: Based in Antalya, our firm serves individual and corporate clients across Muratpaşa, Konyaaltı, Kepez, Döşemealtı and the surrounding districts. Well-versed in the region's dense legal needs in tourism, construction, real estate and commerce, our team closely follows local dynamics to provide practical, well-targeted solutions. For clients reaching us from outside Antalya or abroad, we can also run our processes smoothly through online meetings and digital document management.
about.expertiseBody: From criminal cases to family law, from commercial disputes to real estate transactions, we stand by our clients across a wide range of services. You can find detailed information about each of our practice areas on our Services page.
about.missionBody: To facilitate access to justice through carefully tailored legal strategies for every client.
about.visionBody: To be the preferred law firm in and around Antalya, built on trust, transparency and expertise.
about.teamBody: Our team of expert attorneys and advisors approaches every case with the same care and professionalism.

step1.title: Initial Consultation
step1.body: We listen to your situation and map out the legal path together.

step2.title: Case Review & Strategy
step2.body: Our expert team analyzes your case and prepares the most suitable strategy.

step3.title: Legal Process Follow-up
step3.body: We keep you regularly informed at every stage of the process.

step4.title: Outcome & Reporting
step4.body: At the end of the process, we share the outcome with you clearly and transparently.

f1.question: Is the initial consultation paid?
f1.answer: In the initial meeting, we assess your situation together and inform you about the legal process ahead. Fees are clarified after the meeting based on the nature of the case.

f2.question: What areas of law do you practice?
f2.answer: We offer advisory and litigation services across a wide range of areas, primarily criminal, family, labor, commercial, real estate, enforcement & bankruptcy, inheritance, and contract law.

f3.question: How can I book an appointment?
f3.answer: You can easily request an appointment by filling out the form on our Contact page, or by reaching us via phone or email.

f4.question: How long will my case take?
f4.answer: Duration varies depending on the nature of the case and the court's workload. We provide as realistic a timeline as possible during the initial meeting.

f5.question: Can I get service if I'm outside the city?
f5.answer: Yes, we can handle many of our processes remotely via online meetings, email, and courier.

services.title: Our Practice Areas
services.subtitle: We provide legal counsel and litigation support in the following areas with our expert team.
services.benefitsTitle: What We Offer in This Area

ceza-hukuku.title: Criminal Law
ceza-hukuku.shortDescription: Effective defense and legal representation throughout investigation and prosecution.
ceza-hukuku.description: Our Criminal Law team protects clients' rights at every stage of detention, questioning, investigation and prosecution. We develop effective defense strategies in all criminal proceedings, whether as suspect, defendant or victim.
benefits: Legal support during detention and questioning
Thorough review of the investigation file
Effective defense and representation at trial

aile-hukuku.title: Family Law
aile-hukuku.shortDescription: Legal support in divorce, alimony, custody and property division matters.
aile-hukuku.description: We carefully protect our clients' rights in contested and uncontested divorce, alimony, custody, matrimonial property regime and compensation cases, aiming to conclude the process with minimal strain.
benefits: Representation in uncontested and contested divorce
Advisory on alimony and custody disputes
Handling property division and compensation claims

is-hukuku.title: Labor Law
is-hukuku.shortDescription: Litigation and advisory services in disputes between employees and employers.
is-hukuku.description: We offer services in reinstatement, severance and notice pay, overtime, workplace accident and mobbing cases, as well as advisory support for employment contracts and HR processes on the employer side.
benefits: Representation in reinstatement and compensation cases
Drafting and reviewing employment contracts
Advisory on workplace accident and mobbing cases

ticaret-hukuku.title: Commercial & Corporate Law
ticaret-hukuku.shortDescription: Advisory services on company formation, contracts and commercial disputes.
ticaret-hukuku.description: We provide comprehensive legal support to our corporate clients in company formation, mergers and acquisitions, partnership agreements, drafting commercial contracts, and resolving commercial disputes.
benefits: Advisory on company formation and structuring
Drafting and negotiating commercial contracts
Legal support in partnership and merger processes

gayrimenkul-hukuku.title: Real Estate Law
gayrimenkul-hukuku.shortDescription: Legal representation in title deed, lease, expropriation and construction disputes.
gayrimenkul-hukuku.description: We provide expert support in title deed cancellation and registration, lease disputes, condominium ownership, expropriation valuation, and disputes arising from construction contracts.
benefits: Representation in title deed cancellation cases
Advisory on lease and condominium disputes
Handling expropriation valuation processes

icra-iflas-hukuku.title: Enforcement & Bankruptcy Law
icra-iflas-hukuku.shortDescription: Effective solutions in debt collection and enforcement proceedings.
icra-iflas-hukuku.description: We provide fast and effective legal solutions to both creditors and debtors in initiating enforcement proceedings, debt collection, objection cancellation/removal, and bankruptcy processes.
benefits: Initiating enforcement proceedings and debt collection
Objection cancellation and removal processes
Advisory on bankruptcy and composition proceedings

miras-hukuku.title: Inheritance Law
miras-hukuku.shortDescription: Legal advisory on succession, estate division and reduction claims.
miras-hukuku.description: We protect our clients' rights in obtaining certificates of inheritance, renunciation of inheritance, heirship documents, reduction claims and estate division disputes.
benefits: Certificate of inheritance and heirship procedures
Representation in estate division and reduction cases
Advisory on renunciation of inheritance

sozlesmeler-hukuku.title: Contract Law
sozlesmeler-hukuku.shortDescription: Drafting, review and dispute resolution for all types of contracts.
sozlesmeler-hukuku.description: We advise individual and corporate clients on drafting, negotiating and reviewing contracts, as well as resolving disputes arising from them.
benefits: Drafting contract templates
Legal review of existing contracts
Resolving contract disputes
